content.json: ## Tier 1 — Cost & Reliability (top priority) — *Be aware of running cost, reduce cost, improve UX quality — system running fast, nothing breaking.*
### Cost awareness — *from `azure_cost_snapshot`/`azure_cost_slice`, mirrored by `scripts/sweep_azure_cost.py`, not on a schedule yet — see the STALE flag in this row's own detail text.*

content.query:
let rows = AppEvents
    | where Name == "azure_cost_snapshot"
    | extend d = parse_json(Properties);
let latest_ts = toscalar(rows | summarize max(TimeGenerated));
rows
| where TimeGenerated == latest_ts
| project month_to_date_spend = todouble(d.month_to_date_total),
          budget_amount = todouble(d.budget_amount),
          month_end_forecast = todouble(d.budget_forecast_spend),
          currency = tostring(d.currency),
          snapshot_age_hours = round((now() - latest_ts) / 1h, 1)
| extend spend_pct = iff(budget_amount > 0, round(100.0 * month_to_date_spend / budget_amount, 1), real(null)),
         forecast_pct = iff(budget_amount > 0, round(100.0 * month_end_forecast / budget_amount, 1), real(null))
| project Metrics = pack_array(
    pack("Metric", "Month-to-date spend", "Value", spend_pct, "Detail", strcat(currency, " ", tostring(round(month_to_date_spend, 1)), " of ", currency, " ", tostring(round(budget_amount, 1)), " budget -- snapshot ", tostring(snapshot_age_hours), "h old, STALE pending scheduled sweep (Fix 1, Gap 322)")),
    pack("Metric", "Budget", "Value", -1.0, "Detail", strcat(currency, " ", tostring(round(budget_amount, 1)))),
    pack("Metric", "Month-end forecast", "Value", forecast_pct, "Detail", strcat(currency, " ", tostring(round(month_end_forecast, 1)), " projected vs. ", currency, " ", tostring(round(budget_amount, 1)), " budget -- snapshot ", tostring(snapshot_age_hours), "h old, STALE pending scheduled sweep"))
  )
| mv-expand Metrics
| project Metric = tostring(Metrics.Metric), Value = todouble(Metrics.Value), Detail = tostring(Metrics.Detail)
content.title: Month-to-date spend vs. budget vs. forecast (INR) — Value is % of budget, actual amounts in Detail. STALE FLAG: reads the last azure_cost_snapshot write; scripts/sweep_azure_cost.py is not yet scheduled, so this figure's real age is surfaced in Detail rather than presented as live.

content.query:
let rows = AppEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Name == "ops_recommendation"
    | extend d = parse_json(Properties)
    | extend run_ts = todatetime(tostring(d.generated_at));
let latest_run = toscalar(rows | summarize max(run_ts));
rows
| where run_ts == latest_run
| where tostring(d["category"]) == "cost"
| project
    Category       = tostring(d["title"]),
    Status         = tostring(d.status),
    Explanation    = tostring(d.explanation),
    Recommendation = iff(isempty(tostring(d.recommendation)), "No recommendation yet", tostring(d.recommendation)),
    Findings       = toint(d.finding_count),
    Red            = toint(d.red_count),
    Yellow         = toint(d.yellow_count),
    Errors         = tostring(d.errors),
    Run            = strcat(tostring(d.run_label), " @ ", tostring(d.generated_at))
| order by Category asc
content.title: Latest recommendation — cost (from `ops_recommendation`). No colouring on purpose: worst_severity can be red while recommendation is empty (status != recommend), and colouring that would visually contradict "No recommendation yet". Cost-awareness verdict for Tier 1; the same category's cost-reduction context lives in Tier 3 below.

content.json: ### Reliability — container CPU/memory, restarts (24h), database health, cache health, failed message queue (DLQ), recent alerts

content.query:
let cpu_mem = AzureMetrics
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | where ResourceId has "MICROSOFT.APP/CONTAINERAPPS"
    | where MetricName in ("CpuPercentage", "MemoryPercentage")
    | summarize Value = round(avg(Average), 1) by App = tolower(tostring(split(ResourceId, "/")[-1])), MetricName
    | evaluate pivot(MetricName, avg(Value));
let allowed_reasons = dynamic(["SuccessfulRescale","TriggeredScaleUp","ReplicaUnhealthy","ContainerCrashing","RevisionUpdate"]);
let reason_text = datatable(Reason_s: string, PlainEnglish: string)
[
    "SuccessfulRescale", "scaled up/down",
    "TriggeredScaleUp", "scaled up due to load",
    "ReplicaUnhealthy", "a replica became unhealthy",
    "ContainerCrashing", "a container crashed and restarted",
    "RevisionUpdate", "a new version was deployed"
];
let recent_events = ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Reason_s in (allowed_reasons)
    | summarize (LatestTs, Reason_s) = arg_max(TimeGenerated, Reason_s) by App = tolower(ContainerAppName_s)
    | lookup kind=leftouter reason_text on Reason_s
    | extend AgeMinutes = round((now() - LatestTs) / 1m, 0)
    | extend RelativeTime = iff(AgeMinutes < 60, strcat(tostring(AgeMinutes), "m ago"), strcat(tostring(round(AgeMinutes / 60.0, 1)), "h ago"))
    | extend RecentActivity = strcat(PlainEnglish, ", ", RelativeTime)
    | project App, RecentActivity;
cpu_mem
| join kind=leftouter recent_events on App
| project App, ["CPU%"] = CpuPercentage, ["Memory%"] = MemoryPercentage, ["Recent Activity"] = iff(isempty(RecentActivity), "", RecentActivity)
| order by App asc
content.title: Current CPU% / memory% (last 1h average, per container app) — Recent Activity is ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL-derived, filtered to 5 real event types, plain-English translated

content.query:

content.query:
let restarts = AzureMetrics
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
    | where ResourceId has "MICROSOFT.APP/CONTAINERAPPS"
    | where MetricName == "RestartCount"
    | summarize Restarts24h = sum(Total) by App = tolower(tostring(split(ResourceId, "/")[-1]))
    | where Restarts24h > 0;
let allowed_reasons = dynamic(["SuccessfulRescale","TriggeredScaleUp","ReplicaUnhealthy","ContainerCrashing","RevisionUpdate"]);
let reason_text = datatable(Reason_s: string, PlainEnglish: string)
[
    "SuccessfulRescale", "scaled up/down",
    "TriggeredScaleUp", "scaled up due to load",
    "ReplicaUnhealthy", "a replica became unhealthy",
    "ContainerCrashing", "a container crashed and restarted",
    "RevisionUpdate", "a new version was deployed"
];
let recent_events = ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Reason_s in (allowed_reasons)
    | summarize (LatestTs, Reason_s) = arg_max(TimeGenerated, Reason_s) by App = tolower(ContainerAppName_s)
    | lookup kind=leftouter reason_text on Reason_s
    | extend AgeMinutes = round((now() - LatestTs) / 1m, 0)
    | extend RelativeTime = iff(AgeMinutes < 60, strcat(tostring(AgeMinutes), "m ago"), strcat(tostring(round(AgeMinutes / 60.0, 1)), "h ago"))
    | extend RecentActivity = strcat(PlainEnglish, ", ", RelativeTime)
    | project App, RecentActivity;
restarts
| join kind=leftouter recent_events on App
| project App, Restarts24h, ["Recent Activity"] = iff(isempty(RecentActivity), "", RecentActivity)
| order by Restarts24h desc
content.title: Restart count, last 24h (0 rows = 0 restarts, a real zero)

content.query:
let util = AzureMetrics
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
    | where ResourceId has "PSQL-INVOICELLM-DEV"
    | where MetricName in ("cpu_percent", "memory_percent", "storage_percent")
    | summarize Value = round(avg(Average), 1) by MetricName
    | extend Metric = case(
        MetricName == "cpu_percent", "CPU %",
        MetricName == "memory_percent", "Memory %",
        MetricName == "storage_percent", "Disk %",
        MetricName)
    | extend Status = case(Value >= 90, "critical", Value >= 70, "warning", "healthy")
    | extend Detail = strcat(tostring(Value), "% (6h avg)")
    | extend ["Recent Activity"] = ""
    | project Metric, Status, Detail, ["Recent Activity"];
let conns = AzureMetrics
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
    | where ResourceId has "PSQL-INVOICELLM-DEV"
    | where MetricName in ("active_connections", "max_connections")
    | summarize Value = round(avg(Average), 1) by MetricName
    | extend Metric = case(MetricName == "active_connections", "Active connections", "Max connections")
    | extend Status = "info"
    | extend Detail = tostring(Value)
    | extend ["Recent Activity"] = ""
    | project Metric, Status, Detail, ["Recent Activity"];
let connutil = AzureMetrics
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
    | where ResourceId has "PSQL-INVOICELLM-DEV"
    | where MetricName in ("active_connections", "max_connections")
    | summarize Value = avg(Average) by MetricName
    | evaluate pivot(MetricName, avg(Value))
    | extend Pct = iff(max_connections > 0, round(100.0 * active_connections / max_connections, 1), real(null))
    | extend Metric = "Connection utilization %"
    | extend Status = case(Pct >= 90, "critical", Pct >= 70, "warning", "healthy")
    | extend Detail = strcat(tostring(Pct), "%")
    | extend ["Recent Activity"] = ""
    | project Metric, Status, Detail, ["Recent Activity"];
let live = AzureMetrics
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
    | where ResourceId has "PSQL-INVOICELLM-DEV"
    | where MetricName == "is_db_alive"
    | summarize (latest_ts, latest_value) = arg_max(TimeGenerated, Average);
let blips6h = toscalar(
    AzureMetrics
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
    | where ResourceId has "PSQL-INVOICELLM-DEV"
    | where MetricName == "is_db_alive"
    | where Average < 1
    | count
    | project Count);
let liveness = live
    | extend Metric = "Liveness"
    | extend Status = iff(latest_value >= 1, "healthy", "critical")
    | extend Detail = strcat(blips6h, " sub-1 samples in last 6h")
    | extend ["Recent Activity"] = iff(blips6h > 0, strcat(blips6h, " liveness dip(s) in the last 6h"), "")
    | project Metric, Status, Detail, ["Recent Activity"];
union util, conns, connutil, liveness
| extend SortOrder = case(
    Metric == "CPU %", 1,
    Metric == "Memory %", 2,
    Metric == "Disk %", 3,
    Metric == "Connection utilization %", 4,
    Metric == "Active connections", 5,
    Metric == "Max connections", 6,
    Metric == "Liveness", 7,
    8)
| order by SortOrder asc
| project-away SortOrder
content.title: PostgreSQL (psql-invoicellm-dev) — utilization, connections, liveness. 6h average unless noted; Liveness is real-time (last 15 min sample, not a 6h average that could stay Down for 6h after a single blip has recovered). Recent Activity is Postgres's own liveness-dip signal — managed PaaS, not a container app, so ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL does not apply here.

content.query:
let load_metrics = AzureMetrics
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
    | where ResourceId has "REDIS-INVOICELLM-DEV"
    | where MetricName in ("serverLoad", "usedmemorypercentage")
    | summarize Value = round(avg(Average), 1) by MetricName;
let high_load_samples = toscalar(
    AzureMetrics
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
    | where ResourceId has "REDIS-INVOICELLM-DEV"
    | where MetricName in ("serverLoad", "usedmemorypercentage")
    | where Average >= 90
    | count
    | project Count);
let util = load_metrics
    | extend Metric = case(MetricName == "serverLoad", "Server load %", "Memory used %")
    | extend Status = case(Value >= 90, "critical", Value >= 70, "warning", "healthy")
    | extend Detail = strcat(tostring(Value), "%")
    | extend ["Recent Activity"] = iff(MetricName == "serverLoad" and high_load_samples > 0, strcat(high_load_samples, " sample(s) >=90% load in last 6h"), "")
    | project Metric, Status, Detail, ["Recent Activity"];
let counts = AzureMetrics
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
    | where ResourceId has "REDIS-INVOICELLM-DEV"
    | where MetricName in ("connectedclients", "cachehits", "cachemisses")
    | summarize Value = round(avg(Average), 1) by MetricName
    | extend Metric = case(
        MetricName == "connectedclients", "Connected clients",
        MetricName == "cachehits", "Cache hits",
        MetricName == "cachemisses", "Cache misses",
        MetricName)
    | extend Status = "info"
    | extend Detail = tostring(Value)
    | extend ["Recent Activity"] = ""
    | project Metric, Status, Detail, ["Recent Activity"];
let hitratio = AzureMetrics
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
    | where ResourceId has "REDIS-INVOICELLM-DEV"
    | where MetricName in ("cachehits", "cachemisses")
    | summarize Value = avg(Average) by MetricName
    | evaluate pivot(MetricName, avg(Value))
    | extend Pct = iff((cachehits + cachemisses) > 0, round(100.0 * cachehits / (cachehits + cachemisses), 1), real(null))
    | extend Metric = "Cache hit ratio %"
    | extend Status = case(isnull(Pct), "info", Pct < 50, "critical", Pct < 80, "warning", "healthy")
    | extend Detail = iff(isnull(Pct), "no cache traffic in 6h", strcat(tostring(Pct), "%"))
    | extend ["Recent Activity"] = ""
    | project Metric, Status, Detail, ["Recent Activity"];
let georep = AzureMetrics
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
    | where ResourceId has "REDIS-INVOICELLM-DEV"
    | where MetricName == "geoReplicationHealthy"
    | summarize Value = avg(Average)
    | extend Metric = "Geo-replication health"
    | extend Status = case(isnull(Value), "info", Value >= 1, "healthy", "critical")
    | extend Detail = case(isnull(Value), "not configured in this tier", Value >= 1, "Healthy", "Unhealthy")
    | extend ["Recent Activity"] = ""
    | project Metric, Status, Detail, ["Recent Activity"];
union util, counts, hitratio, georep
| extend SortOrder = case(
    Metric == "Server load %", 1,
    Metric == "Memory used %", 2,
    Metric == "Connected clients", 3,
    Metric == "Cache hits", 4,
    Metric == "Cache misses", 5,
    Metric == "Cache hit ratio %", 6,
    Metric == "Geo-replication health", 7,
    8)
| order by SortOrder asc
| project-away SortOrder
content.title: Redis (redis-invoicellm-dev) — utilization, client/cache counts, cache hit ratio, geo-replication. 6h average. Cache hit ratio is inverted from the usual scale (low is bad); reads 'info' with no traffic to compute a ratio from, not a false healthy. Geo-replication reads 'info' if the metric isn't reporting (e.g. not configured in this tier) rather than a false Unhealthy. Recent Activity is Redis's own high-load-sample signal — managed PaaS, not a container app, so ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL does not apply here.

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Log_s has "POISON MESSAGE ISOLATED"
| project TimeGenerated, ContainerAppName_s, Log_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

content.json: ## Recent Alerts — *covers all alert rules in `alert-rules.bicep`; nothing here creates or edits one*

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ "microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts"
| extend fired = todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime),
         sev = tostring(properties.essentials.severity)
| where fired > ago(14d)
| summarize Value = count() by Day = bin(fired, 1d), Severity = sev
| order by Day desc, Severity asc
content.title: Alerts fired per day, by severity — last 14 days (real daily binning via bin(fired, 1d), not a cumulative count). Kept as a line chart — trend visibility is the point, not a table.

content.json: ### Speed — major API latency by feature area vs. industry standard, API error rate by area. *Reference values (last 7d): Auth/Ingestion sub-second is good; Chat 2–10s P50 is normal for agentic RAG; Dashboard Insights is bimodal (13–23s cache-miss vs. sub-second cache-hit — see the panel below).*

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where AppRoleName != "invoice-be-local-f20-verify"
| extend Area = case(
    Name has "/invoices" or Name has "/email-ingestion", "Ingestion & Extraction",
    Name has "/chat",                                    "Chat",
    Name has "/audit",                                   "Review & Correction",
    Name has "/autopilot" or Name has "/connectors",     "Autopilot & Connectors",
    Name has "/dashboard",                               "Dashboard & Reporting",
    Name has "/trainer",                                 "Trainer",
    Name has "/billing" or Name has "/admin",            "Billing & Admin",
    Name has "/settings/security" or Name has "/auth",   "Auth",
    "Other")
| summarize Requests = sum(ItemCount),
            P95ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 1)
  by Area
| project Metrics = pack_array(
    pack("Metric", strcat(Area, " — Requests"), "Value", tostring(Requests), "Detail", "Total requests, last 30 days"),
    pack("Metric", strcat(Area, " — P95 latency"), "Value", strcat(tostring(P95ms), " ms"), "Detail", "95th percentile latency, last 30 days")
  )
| mv-expand Metrics
| project Metric = tostring(Metrics.Metric), Value = tostring(Metrics.Value), Detail = tostring(Metrics.Detail)
| order by Metric asc
content.title: Requests / P95 latency by feature area, last 30 days — no status color (see Error rate panel below for the colored signal).

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where AppRoleName != "invoice-be-local-f20-verify"
| extend Area = case(
    Name has "/invoices" or Name has "/email-ingestion", "Ingestion & Extraction",
    Name has "/chat",                                    "Chat",
    Name has "/audit",                                   "Review & Correction",
    Name has "/autopilot" or Name has "/connectors",     "Autopilot & Connectors",
    Name has "/dashboard",                               "Dashboard & Reporting",
    Name has "/trainer",                                 "Trainer",
    Name has "/billing" or Name has "/admin",            "Billing & Admin",
    Name has "/settings/security" or Name has "/auth",   "Auth",
    "Other")
| summarize ErrorRatePct = round(100.0 * sumif(ItemCount, Success == false) / sum(ItemCount), 1) by Area
| project Metric = strcat(Area, " — Error rate"), Value = ErrorRatePct
| order by Metric asc
content.title: Error rate by feature area, last 30 days.

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where AppRoleName != "invoice-be-local-f20-verify"
| where Name has "/dashboard/insights"
| extend Bucket = iff(DurationMs < 2000, "cache-hit-like (<2s)", "cache-miss-like (>=2s)")
| summarize Requests = count(), P50ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 50), 1), P95ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 1) by Bucket
| project Metrics = pack_array(
    pack("Metric", strcat(Bucket, " -- Requests"), "Value", tostring(Requests), "Detail", "Total requests, last 30 days, bucketed by duration (AppRequests carries no explicit cache-hit flag)"),
    pack("Metric", strcat(Bucket, " -- P50/P95 (ms)"), "Value", strcat(tostring(P50ms), " / ", tostring(P95ms)), "Detail", "duration percentiles within this bucket")
  )
| mv-expand Metrics
| project Metric = tostring(Metrics.Metric), Value = tostring(Metrics.Value), Detail = tostring(Metrics.Detail)
| order by Metric asc
content.title: Dashboard Insights latency — cache-hit vs. cache-miss bimodal split. GET /api/v1/dashboard/insights measured 13-23s on a cache miss, sub-second on a cache hit. Observability only — actually fixing the latency (pre-warming the cache or a background job) is out of scope.

content.json: ## Tier 3 — Cost Reduction (lowest priority, deliberately smallest section) — *where spend concentrates. See the AI Control Tower workbook's Tier 3 for the LLM-call cost split; a genuine chat-vs-extraction-vs-judging cost split is a known future enhancement, not built yet.*

content.query:
AppEvents
| where Name == "azure_cost_slice"
| extend d = parse_json(Properties)
| where tostring(d.dimension) == "ServiceName"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, amount = todouble(d.amount)) by service = tostring(d.dimension_value)
| project Metric = service, Value = strcat("INR ", tostring(round(amount, 1)))
| order by Metric asc

content.json: *Single-page, deliberately — tabs render unreliably in this workbook engine.*
